card.name: Linking words before expected noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, from or or, and the adjective detailed, placed just before a noun phrase that is strongly predictable from the context. Most often seen in the antidepressant screening sentence, where it fires on 'detailed' before 'psychiatric history'.

modes.label: Adjective in screening advice
modes.description: The word 'detailed' before 'psychiatric history' in the antidepressant bipolar-screening warning.

modes.description: The word 'of' or 'from' inside a book title or a quoted line, just before the next noun.

modes.label: Or between disease names
modes.description: The word 'or' joining two related disease names in a dosing heading.
